newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siam Comm sets US$1.5 bln MTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Siam Comm sets US$1.5 bln MTN programme.

text.p: Siam Commercial Bank Public Co Ltd has signed a US$1.5 billion global medium term note programme, arranger Merrill Lynch said on Friday.
The programme was established through the Hong Kong branch, Singapore branch or London branch of the bank, it said.
The programme was arranged by Merrill Lynch International, Merrill Lynch (Singapore) Pte Ltd and Merrill Lynch Capital Markets Bank Ltd Frankfurt am Main branch.

Under the programme, the bank may issue senior and subordinated notes and certificates of deposit (CDs) in an amount outstanding at any time of up to US$1.5 billion or its equivalent in other currencies.
The notes or CDs issued under the programme will be eligible for listing on the London Stock Exchange and/or the Stock Exchange of Singapore and for clearance through DTC, Euroclear or Cedel Bank.
For the first time, it is intended that the notes or CDs issued under this programme will be cleared by the Central Moneymarkets Unit in Hong Kong.
The programme has been rated A3 for senior and subordinated notes by Moody's Investors Service and BBB-plus for senior notes and BBB for subordinated notes by Standard & Poor's Corp.

The dealer group comprises Merrill Lynch International, Merrill Lynch (Singapore) Pte Ltd, Chase Manhattan Asia, Chase Manhattan (SEA), Dresdner Bank, Lehman Brothers International (Europe), Lehman Brothers Inc Singapore branch, LTCB Asia, NatWest Capital Markets Sanwa International Finance and Swiss Bank Corp, Merril Lynch said.
The Law Debenture Trust Corp is acting as the trustee and the First National Bank of Chicago is the principal paying agent, transfer agent and registrar.
Merrill Lynch Capital Markets Bank Ltd Frankfurt am Main branch has been appointed as arranger for issues of mark-denominated notes.
